title: Cameroon Okra Egusi Soup
author: Precious Nkeih (BN Cuisine, BellaNaija)
desc: Meat boiled until tender, a ground-egusi paste cooked 10 minutes, smoked fish, crayfish and seasoning, and chopped okra added last so it stays green and vibrant.
longDesc: Precious Nkeih’s ‘the Cameroonian way’ okra egusi soup starts with boiling meat until tender, seasoning halfway with salt and a quarter of the chopped onions. The ground egusi paste is added and cooked 10 minutes, smoked fish another 5 to 10 minutes, then the seasoning cubes, salt and crayfish simmer two minutes. Okra goes in for 2 to 5 minutes; the page says it should still look green and vibrant. Served with cooked garri or any fufu of choice.
ingredients: 1/2 pound okra (about 1/4 kg), finely chopped or roughly blended
1 pound fish, meat or both (smoked fish and beef used)
1 large crayfish seasoning cube (Maggi Crevette) or 3 small seasoning cubes
steps: Boil the meat until tender. Halfway through, season with salt and a quarter of the chopped onions. (The boiling time is not printed.)
Add the ground egusi paste and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the smoked fish and cook another 5 to 10 minutes.
Add the seasoning cubes, salt and crayfish and simmer for two minutes.
Add the okra and cook 2 to 5 minutes. It should still look green and vibrant.
Serve with cooked garri or any fufu of choice.
chefTips: The page’s cue for the okra is that it should still look green and vibrant — do not overcook it.
Printed cue for the meat: ‘until tender’.
Three-quarters of the onion is not used in the printed method; add it as you see fit and note the gap.
commonMistakes: Adding the okra before the egusi has cooked its 10 minutes.
Boiling the meat too little before seasoning.
healthBenefits: Egusi and fish add protein and fat; okra adds vegetable.
culturalNote: The page describes it as made the Cameroonian way and uses the Nigerian-sounding name egusi for melon seeds. No region within Cameroon is stated.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Cameroon Okra Egusi Soup’. Byline as printed: ‘Precious Nkeih’ (series ‘BN Cuisine’, BellaNaija). ‘May 14, 2017’. Yield and total time not printed (servings 4 and the prep/cook split are placeholders for the app; the stated times are 10, 5–10, 2 and 2–5 minutes). TWO-PASS.
ABSENT: salt quantity; meat boiling time; what happens to the remaining three-quarters of the onion.
